variants.headline: Business plan abandoned before opening
variants.body: The founder {founder} has abandoned the plan for {business} before opening. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: An intended company will not open
variants.body: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: A household's business plan ends
variants.body: The business plan made by {founder} has been abandoned before the company opened. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
